title: TypeScript errors in @flash/core production code: readonly mutation, missing AST property, unused var
description:
Running 'cd packages/core && npx tsc --noEmit' shows 6 TypeScript errors in production code:

1. model/timeline.ts lines 257, 262, 272, 279 — TS2540: Cannot assign to 'type' because it is a read-only property.
   In setLayerType(), the code creates shallow Layer copies with { ...l } but then mutates l.type directly.
   Since Layer.type is readonly, TypeScript rejects this. Runtime works because JS doesn't enforce readonly,
   but it is incorrect TypeScript. Fix: construct each modified layer with the correct type inline, e.g.
   { ...newLayers[li]!, type } instead of mutating after the spread.

2. as2/formatter.ts line 100 — TS2339: Property 'expression' does not exist on type 'Block | ExprStmt'.
   An AST node type is likely used without proper type narrowing. A Block node and an ExprStmt node are
   in a union; formatter.ts accesses .expression without narrowing to ExprStmt first.
   Fix: add a type guard or narrow to ExprStmt before accessing .expression.

3. as2/compiler.ts line 2632 — TS6133: 'memberExprToString' is declared but its value is never read.
   Unused function/variable. Fix: remove it or suppress with /* eslint-disable */.

The readonly mutation is the most concerning since it violates TypeScript's const-correctness invariants.
